Class HonestNodeBehaviorLimited

java.lang.Object
ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.bitcoin.node.DefaultNodeBehavior
ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.bitcoin.node.HonestNodeBehavior
ca.yorku.cmg.cnsim.bitcoin.node.HonestNodeBehaviorLimited
All Implemented Interfaces:
NodeBehaviorStrategy
public class HonestNodeBehaviorLimited extends HonestNodeBehavior
A testing-only variant of HonestNodeBehavior that loosens two validation checks so unit tests can drive predictable flows through the pool and mining logic without the full blockchain-consistency machinery engaging.

Two behaviors are weakened relative to the standard honest strategy:

  • The "is this transaction already in the local structure?" guard is removed, letting a test replay the same transaction through the pool without the blockchain silently swallowing it.
  • New-block reception is reduced to a bare structure insertion — no pool extraction, no mining-pool reconstruction, no reconsideration of mining. Test state therefore remains deterministic across block arrivals.

Not intended for production simulations. HiddenChainAttackBehavior also uses this class as its altHonestBehavior so that public-chain blocks received during an attack do not clear the attacker's pool.

Author:
Sotirios Liaskos for the Conceptual Modeling Group @ York University

    • handleNewBlockReception

      protected void handleNewBlockReception(Block b)
      Minimal new-block integration: adds the block to the node's structure and stops. Unlike the base class, this override does not extract the block's transactions from the pool, does not reconstruct the mining pool, and does not reconsider whether the node should be mining. Keeps pool contents deterministic across block arrivals in tests and keeps the attacker's pool untouched when used as the altHonestBehavior of HiddenChainAttackBehavior.
      Overrides:
      handleNewBlockReception in class DefaultNodeBehavior
      Parameters:
      b - the received block
